selected_script.angle: Tackling entryway footwear clutter with clear-view hanging storage
selected_script.hook: Tired of tripping over messy piles of shoes every single day?

usage_steps_used: Hang the 4 metal hooks over the top edge of the door
Attach the top metal rings of the organizer onto the 4 metal hooks
Insert shoes or items into the 20 angled clear-side pockets

script_record.0-3s: A close-up shot of a bedroom floor cluttered with a messy heap of shoes, showing a person accidentally tripping over them.
script_record.3-6s: A hand hangs the 4 metal hooks over the top edge of the door frame, then attaches the top reinforced metal rings of the black 10-tier organizer onto the hooks.
script_record.6-10s: A hand slides a pair of men's sneakers into one of the 20 angled pockets, showcasing the clear PVC side panels.
script_record.10-14s: A fast cut showing various women's heels and boots being neatly slid into different tiers.
script_record.14-18s: A final panning shot of the entire door hanging shoe organizer fully loaded, displaying a perfectly neat and organized space.
script_record.18-20s: On-screen text: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' with a light CTA.

Use the provided product reference images: a black non-woven fabric hanging shoe organizer with transparent PVC side panels and 10 tiers. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Maintain high product consistency.
